scorecard.name: crypto touch-sell (model vs market)
scorecard.detail: zero-drift lognormal w/ EWMA vol prices touch markets (reach $X / dip to $Y by DATE) off the coin's own history; sell YES when model is 10c+ under the market, hold to resolution. Config locked before the OOS pass. IS (2023-03..2025-08) +11.1%/staked-$ over 196 trades; OOS (2025-09..2026-07) +27.7% over 49 trades, cluster-bootstrap 5th pct +7.4%, 9 of 11 months positive. Full period CAGR +19%, max DD -32% (Nov-Dec 2024 bull: selling touch_up bleeds in violent trends - the disclosed regime risk). Buy side of the same signal LOSES (-8c/trade): when the market is 20c above the model it knows something; when 20c below it is lottery demand. Only questions that name their own deadline are traded ('by Dec 31', not 'before GTA VI').

scorecard.name: neg-risk fancied-leg selling
scorecard.verdict: promising - gate closed (OOS CI through zero)
scorecard.detail: legs of mutually-exclusive events trading 25-75c with 30-250d left resolve YES 23-29% vs 41-43% priced; mirror-image cheap near-certainties confirm the mechanism (flow chases salient names). IS +9.1%/staked-$ (447 legs, 247 events, CAGR +32%); OOS mean +5.2% but event-bootstrap 5th pct -3.7% on 115 events - by this desk's gate rule that is not yet tradeable. pm_negrisk.py reruns the split as data accrues.

scorecard.name: status-quo premium (sell long-dated mid YES)
scorecard.detail: sell edge in both halves vanishes once negRisk legs are excluded: IS +4.8c, OOS -2.3c/trade net. The coarse-scan cells that cleared both halves were negRisk structure plus 81-cell selection.

scorecard.name: post-jump momentum / reversal
scorecard.detail: after a >=10c daily move, continuation loses -8.6c IS / -7.7c OOS net; reversal -0.7c / -1.8c. Nothing clears costs on either side of the split.

scorecard.name: overnight weather forecast-vs-market
scorecard.detail: venue-wide pool $35,182 profit on $92,596 staked May-Jul at model-EV>=10c; positive all 3 months, 11 cities, 96% of nights; error dist trained Feb-Apr only; entries = real same-side prints; largest print verified vs live API. Mid-morning version LOSES -40%/trade (market Brier 0.018 beats model 0.031 by 10am). Live capture share now being measured by pm_wxedge.py

scorecard.name: deep-longshot selling
scorecard.detail: sell YES 1-5c on standalone binaries 30-250d out: +7.8%/yr walk-forward 2023-26, 526 trades, 4 losses, 3 losing months of 37; the only survivor of a 90-rule scan under a strict temporal split; sizing above 5%/pos inverts it

scorecard.name: market making
